icons.name: booking-confirmed
icons.heading: Booking confirmed
icons.description: A check is written onto the calendar to confirm the booking. Light: the short stroke of the check draws down to the corner, the long stroke draws up a beat later, and the check pops once as the booking is set. Strong: both strokes snap on with hard stops at the corner and the tip, the check pops harder, and the calendar takes it with a thump, a rebound and a settle. The leaf stays rigid.

Strong: the pole strikes up with a dead stop and the calendar takes the hit with a thump and a rebound; the pennant snaps out harder and flutters twice before it settles. The leaf stays rigid.

Light: the clock's minute hand runs round to the send time, and as it lands the paper plane draws back and launches a short way along its nose, shrinking a little as it pulls away, while three speed lines streak out behind it; it springs back to rest with a small overshoot. Strong: the hand winds back and runs round hard, the clock jolts as the time hits, and the plane draws back deeper, shoots farther and smaller, and springs back in two beats.

Strong: the plus strokes snap on with hard stops and it pops harder, the hand winds back, then drives the extra hour round hard, stops dead with a tick back, and the clock takes the stop with a thump and a rebound.

Light: the card is pushed down into the slot on top of the time clock and stops dead, and the clock dips with the punch and settles. Strong: the card lifts a little first, then is slammed into the slot; the clock thumps, rebounds and settles. The reverse clocks out: the clock gives a small kick and the card springs back up out of the slot, overshoots a little and settles.
